title: Stolen Beer Leads to Deadly Shooting
description:
In Las Cruces, New Mexico, an argument over a beer escalated into a fatal encounter when Officer Brad Lunsford shot 36-year-old Presley Eze. Lunsford was later charged with voluntary manslaughter and found guilty by a jury. However, due to juror issues, he was granted a new trial. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
